evidence_digest: A 46-file curated text bundle covers Cargo.toml, build.rs, license/patch docs, permissions, and required Rust sources including dialog additions. Build copies only that allowlist into dist/provider; init stages it under .pumarejo/provider and writes a project-relative Cargo path. Provider-aware manifest, legacy migration, doctor/drift, exact-file removal, foreign/link refusal, tarball-consumer proof, and docs fit the owned paths.
